subject: Claritech pricing follow-up: volume bands, blended rate & budget check
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Sam Walters <sam.walters@claritech.com>, Priya Desai <priya@claritech.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 16:32:00 -0700
Subject: Claritech pricing follow-up: volume bands, blended rate & budget check

Hi Sam / Priya —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our discovery: Claritech is planning to expand two main inference routes over the next 12 months (chat generation + embeddings) and add a third reranking route in Q2. You mentioned expected steady-state volumes and an aggressive expansion plan if unit economics work.

Requested items we promised to follow up on:
- A compact pricing sketch (blended and tiered) that maps to the volume bands you described.
- Confirmation on monthly token profiles per route (chat / embeddings / rerank).
- Your target $/1M tokens (goal for procurement to hit).

Can you confirm approximate monthly tokens per route (even ranges are fine) and overall monthly budget range you have in mind? I attached a simple template to capture the numbers — redwood-pricing-template.xlsx — but a quick bullet reply works too.

Next steps: once you confirm volumes + target $/1M we’ll produce a 1-page amendment with blended rate options and a proposed step-up schedule for renewal/expansion. If that looks good, we can route to legal/finance and prepare a DocuSign amendment.

Thanks —
So{

From: Sam Walters <sam.walters@claritech.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya@claritech.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Claritech pricing follow-up: volume bands, blended rate & budget check

Thanks Soojin — good call. Quick answers below:

Estimated steady monthly volumes (starting Q4):
- Chat generation (primary): 30M - 45M tokens / month
- Embeddings (search & semantic): 12M - 20M tokens / month
- Reranking (pilot): 3M - 8M tokens / month

If we hit product-market fit we plan to increase chat to ~200M tokens/mo within 9–12 months.

Procurement target: we’re aiming for blended economics in the neighborhood of $900–$1,100 per 1M tokens (company target). If you can get us under $1,000/1M on a blended plan at scale that’s likely to make the numbers work for execs.

I attached a small usage extract (claritech-usage-samples.csv) to help with modeling.

Other asks: 12-month model pinning for embeddings would be preferred and any SLA credits you can include for critical endpoints.

Best —
Sam

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Sam Walters <sam.walters@claritech.com>, Priya Desai <priya@claritech.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Claritech pricing follow-up: volume bands, blended rate & budget check

Sam — thanks for the numbers and the target. Appreciate the urgency on hitting sub-$1,000/1M blended at scale. Based on your Q4 starting profile and the scale-up plan, here are two pragmatic packaging options we can propose quickly to finance/legal for an amendment:

Option A — Conservative step-up (lower near-term discounting):
- 0–50M tokens / month: $1,200 per 1M tokens
- 50–250M tokens / month: $900 per 1M tokens (blended once you cross 50M)
- >250M tokens / month: $650 per 1M tokens
Notes: 3-month lookback on volumes to trigger step-up; embeddings route counted separately for minimum commit (see below).

Option B — Aggressive growth incentive (favours faster scale):
- 0–50M: $1,050 per 1M
- 50–150M: $800 per 1M
- >150M: $600 per 1M
Notes: Quarterly volume check, 6-month minimum commitment for the >150M band.

Embedding route: we can offer a 12-month pinned model guaranty for embeddings with an add’l 10% discount off the route price for a 12-month pin (requires legal amendment).

SLA credits: we can include a limited SLA credit schedule for critical endpoints; Lauren / Rishi looped to confirm the exact language and thresholds.

I’ve attached a first-draft amendment (claritech-amendment-draft.pdf) and the pricing template I mentioned earlier (redwood-pricing-template.xlsx) with the two options populated. If you prefer, I can prepare a blended target line (single $/1M) that mixes across the three routes using your expected route weightings — will do that if you send preferred route % splits or confirm the estimated tokens per route.

Proposed near-term next steps:
1) Confirm which Option (A or B) you want to take to execs, or ask us to generate a blended $/1M target using your route weights.
2) If Option chosen, sign the amendment (DocuSign link below) — we’ll route to legal and finance for final review.
3) We’ll schedule a short rollout plan for pinning embeddings and canarying the new rerank route.

DocuSign preview: https://www.docusign.com/claritech/amendment/abcd1234

Thanks —
So{

From: Priya Desai <priya@claritech.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Sam Walters <sam.walters@claritech.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 11:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Claritech pricing follow-up: volume bands, blended rate & budget check

Thanks — this is helpful. A few clarifications from procurement side:

- Can the embeddings 12-month pin be scoped to a specific model (we want reproducible embeddings for search)? We prefer that locked model for the whole year.
- For Option B: is the >150M band a hard cap trigger or can we smooth with a blended step during the quarter?
- SLA credits: please send proposed thresholds (requesting 99.9% endpoint availability for the chat route).

Also: can you push the blended target example as a single $/1M line using our likely route weights (chat 70%, embeddings 25%, rerank 5%)? That will speed discussion with finance.

Attached: security-qa.pdf — we’ll need that for our infra and procurement review.

Best —
Priya

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Priya Desai <priya@claritech.com>, Sam Walters <sam.walters@claritech.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Claritech pricing follow-up: volume bands, blended rate & budget check

Hi Priya / Sam — forwarding Soojin's thread with a couple of approvals and clarifications from finance/legal:

- We can pin a specified embeddings model for 12 months; we’ll list the model name in the amendment and include a roll-forward clause if critical security patches require reversion.
- Blended single-line example (using chat 70% / embeddings 25% / rerank 5%) returns:
  * Option A blended: approximately $1,110 per 1M tokens (month 1 profile)
  * Option B blended: approximately $880 per 1M tokens (growth-weighted projection)

- Regarding smoothing: we can implement a blended smoothing mechanism for quarterly reporting rather than hard thresholds — I’ll ask finance to include a 90-day smoothing window in the amendment.
- SLA: we can target 99.9% for critical chat endpoints with a standard credits ladder (detailed wording to follow).

Action items from our side:
1) Soojin will produce the single-line blended example and a clean amendment with smoothing language.
2) Priya / Sam to confirm the route weights or send final month-by-month projections.
3) If you’re ready, sign the DocuSign preview and we’ll start the legal queue.

-Rishi
